title: Sandbox game mode: rig pawn, floor and distance markers, practice encounter (first playable for VR Preview and the first APK)
acceptance: Default game mode spawns AXRSeatedRigPawn with ARigPlayerController
On an empty map (Entry) it builds a lit floor with distance markers, the objective in front and below, three lane entrances and a looping practice encounter that retries after failure
Never builds the sandbox in other maps or in tests unless asked
description: Found while preparing T-0006: the project has no game mode or map, so a packaged build or VR Preview would show an empty void without the rig. Built in code so no .umap is needed yet; the real Level 1 arena is T-0020.

history.note: Approved by the owner in chat after the headset tests; merged via PR #21. Recorded on the owner's behalf by claude-code-dartonx-pc.

result.summary: AETMSandboxGameMode (Source/ETM/Core/Game) is the project default (GlobalDefaultGameMode in Config/DefaultEngine.ini). Player = AXRSeatedRigPawn + ARigPlayerController; each rig is registered with the mission at StartPlay and on RestartPlayer. On the Entry map (the boot map) with no objective present it builds a range in code: one movable shadowless directional light, a 60 m floor, distance posts at 5/15/30/45 m down three lanes (-35, 0, +35 deg), the objective 4.5 m ahead at floor level with a block for its bulk, three target-point entrances 25 m out facing the rig, and an encounter director running one hour-long practice phase (Shardlings from left and centre, Needle Drones from the right, max 5 active), with automatic retry 3 s after a mission failure.
result.verification: Built on UE 5.8.4, zero errors and warnings; all 78 ETM tests pass, 2 new (ETM.Core.Sandbox.*) using FTestWorldWrapper: the default game mode is the sandbox and does not build the range in non-Entry worlds; BuildSandbox gives an objective ahead and below the eye, three valid entrances, one light without shadows, more than 15 range actors; enemies arrive within 10 s of real world ticks; a rig failure retries by itself and restores the rig; building twice is a no-op. Not yet seen in VR Preview or on a headset.
result.remaining: Placeholder grey shapes on default materials; no sky or ambient light, so faces away from the light are dark. The local editor-rewritten DefaultEngine.ini on the build PC also needs GlobalDefaultGameMode set to the sandbox (done locally, not committed). Real arenas replace the range (T-0020/T-0027); the campaign flow (T-0031) will set its own game mode. Branch agent/claude-code-dartonx-pc/t-0053 needs a PR.
result.next: Review T-0053. Then T-0006: package this as the first APK once the engine's Android target is installed.
